graphPremise: For a transaction spending a UTXO protected by the pinned root program, root position and exact input count are enforced. The successor-lock comparisons, together with ordinary ledger validation of every input and P2SH32 hash binding, force the complete ordered program graph. BN13 uses absolute root pins and preserves inputs 1..12. A particular historical outpoint identity is not asserted.
theoremTransfer: Each inserted root/successor gate is stack-neutral at the original redeem-body boundary; every original arithmetic instruction and every proof/public/state/table/padding unlocking prefix is preserved. The previously qualified finite-domain equation therefore transfers under the original VM/hash/curve premises and the enforced conditional ordered graph. Exact historical outpoint identity remains external.

validation.resourceHolds: BN27 inputs 0 and 8 reach the BCH2026 10000-byte stack-item limit, while inputs 1 and 9 reach the 10000-byte unlocking limit, in consensus and standard modes across three cases (24 evaluations). BN13 has only the two standard-mode operation-cost-density holds at input 1 in extra-0 and worst-case. Oracle and proposed-spec evaluations accept every case.

scope: Existing corrected positive cases only. No proof generation, negative cases, compiler/producer/planner invocation, grouped graph, cybersecurity testing, byte optimization, whole-transaction admission, relay/mainnet conclusion, or neutral-domain completeness claim.
